producer_sites.effect: Collision-response helper sets actor field +0x1A to -8, publishes actor type 0x84, installs 0x00122DB2, and clears actor field +0x37 after its optional response audio call.

conclusion: The formerly unclassified 0x00122DB2 fragment is a shared Type-0x84 response/Type-0x01 handoff. Its two direct producers and its exact ED type publication explain why it is a separate stream rather than part of the stationary ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE01 root.
